title: Origin story: Whisperglass
description: Whisperglass was a glazier's apprentice who discovered that glass remembers sound — every window holds the whispers spoken near it. She became the listener of walls, reading windows like books, and now she is consulted when the truth is trapped in glass: the last words, the secret plans, the unheard confessions.

title: Ability profile: Whisperglass
description: Ranked abilities: Glass-reading — rank 100/100; Listening — rank 99/100; Discretion — rank 97/100; Patience — rank 96/100; Memory — rank 95/100.

title: Power ranking: Whisperglass
description: Powers: Glass yields its stored sound to her; She hears what walls overheard; Windows are her library.

title: Stamina feats: Whisperglass
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Listened for decades; Read a century of windows.

title: Crossover notes: Whisperglass
